prs.title: fix(nuxt,nitro): normalise string/array `appMiddleware`
prs.author: danielroe
prs.body:
### 🔗 Linked issue

### 📚 Description

spotted in migrating kinde to nuxt v5 (https://github.com/nuxt-modules/kinde/pull/597).

h3 v2 doesn't support string/array route rules so we can normalise them to object syntax in nuxt.

prs.title: refactor(webpack,rspack): inline friendly errors plugin
prs.author: danielroe
prs.body:
### 🔗 Linked issue

### 📚 Description

we currently depend on [@nuxt/friendly-errors-webpack-plugin](https://github.com/nuxt/friendly-errors-webpack-plugin) which is not maintained and has some very outdated dependencies.

this moves the implementation into `@nuxt/webpack-builder`

prs.title: fix(kit): lowercase filename-derived handler method on nitro v2
prs.author: danielroe
prs.body:
### 🔗 Linked issue

### 📚 Description

nitro v2 only accepts lower-case methods, and this change fixes a type issue with `$fetch` on nuxt v4

prs.title: fix(vite): resolve inlined `vue` to its bundler build in dev
prs.author: danielroe
prs.body:
### 🔗 Linked issue

### 📚 Description

spotted this when running nuxt v5 without a root `vue` dependency; we get a `ReferenceError: module is not defined`

this is because vite will only externalise a lib in `resolve.dedupe` if it's resolvable in the project root, and if it's not deduped we get the CJS entry, which can't be evaluated...

prs.title: fix(nuxt,nitro): keep failed render headers off the thrown error
prs.author: danielroe
prs.body:
### 🔗 Linked issue

### 📚 Description

with `experimental.inlineErrorRendering: false` (and for payload and island renders), reusing a Nuxt error across requests leaks headers between users.

this was because `rethrowWithResponseHeaders` merged the failed render's response headers into `error.headers`, mutating the thrown error, and `createError()` returns an existing Nuxt error unchanged, so every request that rethrew it was mutating the same object.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> this was only for errors that were _shared_ - e.g. a memoised error or a `const myError = new Error()` top level error

this PR leaves the error alone and instead records the render's response headers on the request state (`event.context.nuxt['~response-headers']`), and drops a workaround the island handler had to avoid that mutation.

prs.title: fix(nitro): keep workerd ssr conditions in miniflare dev runner
prs.author: lokyiec
prs.body:
### 🔗 Linked issue

N/A. Reproduction: https://github.com/lokyiec/nuxt-ssr-workerd-conditions

### 📚 Description

`nuxt dev` with `cloudflare_module` returns 500 (`exports is not defined`) on every page.

`nuxt:nitro:ssr-conditions` overwrites the `workerd` conditions Nitro sets on the `ssr` environment, so `node` comes back and `@vue/server-renderer` resolves to CJS. The plugin now keeps Nitro's conditions and falls back to `exportConditions`.
